name: CHROME LITURGY: Saints of the Augmented
description: A collectible card game where physical smart-ink cards display shifting augmentation schematics and faction allegiances, while BCI-linked players experience additional hidden card layers — secret loyalties, blackmail files, and suppressed upgrade specs — invisible to unaugmented opponents. Cards depicting legendary street surgeons and rogue chromesmiths are the most coveted, some selling for tens of thousands of Quanta on secondary markets. Corponation Vantec-Hale quietly funds tournament circuits to harvest competitive meta-data for product development.
story_hooks: A player wins a high-stakes tournament using a neural card nobody can legally prove exists — its hidden layer contains schematics for a Vantec-Hale prototype that was never released.
A the Gray Zone kid's battered physical-only deck contains a pre-digital misprint that, when scanned by certain BCI models, unlocks a decommissioned corporate subnet.
The rarest card in the game — depicting a mythologized street surgeon called the Pale Seam — may be a recruitment signal for an underground augmentation collective.
